notes: Anything that stays present under a global shuffle is a defect in the bank or in the scorer.

Under the ruled scores a twin no longer counts as the right work — the gate admits only the row's own parent item or its own attachment — so the raised floor a work-identity match used to give is gone. The ladder still scores a twin near-win, and the ladder is reported beside R34 so the difference between the two questions stays visible.
reason: no replies bundle under bench/results/0722-redstate/global-shuffle to re-score, and this is a build arm: producing one means patching fork/src and rebuilding, which needs a built server at fork/dist/index.js (`make upstream-checkout`, then `npm ci && npm run build` in fork/). No reply-level simulation stands in for it — a simulation is evidence about a stipulated reply distribution, not about a build.
